name.full: Day Reminders — schedule and end-of-day check-in

description.short: Personal reminders for what you need to get done today.
description.full: A simple personal tab for capturing what you need to remember today. Set a time on any item to get a notification before it's due. At your configured end-of-day time you'll get an 'Are you done?' check-in listing anything still open. End-of-day time, lead-time, weekday-only mode, notifications and chime are all configurable from the Settings dialog.
